source_title: OECD AI and the future of social protection
unit_or_scope: OECD social programs and AI use cases
direct_observation: Current AI uses center on client support back-office automation and fraud detection while future uses include outreach early intervention and tailored support with privacy error and trust risks
closed_stage: use-case map and governance risk boundary
missing_stage: claimant exposure subgroup accuracy non-take-up notice correction and benefit receipt
next_test: trace one use case from model or automation to claimant review appeal and payment

source_title: OECD Harnessing AI in Social Security
direct_observation: AI is explored for eligibility checks document processing and service delivery and Catalonia has a named energy-poverty eligibility-reporting use case
missing_stage: household enrollment payment continuity false positives and negatives explanation and remedy
next_test: audit Catalonia or another named system for eligibility accuracy notice correction and payment continuity

source_title: OECD Using AI to manage minimum-income benefits and unemployment assistance
direct_observation: AI may improve timeliness and take-up but may produce biased eligibility assessments or increase inequality across information eligibility and undue-payment detection
missing_stage: named performance claimant understanding appeal correction and material outcome
next_test: compare model-assisted and human-only cases by subgroup and outcome

unit_or_scope: public authorities deciding essential benefits and services
direct_observation: AI granting denying reducing revoking or reclaiming essential benefits can affect livelihood and fundamental rights and is high-risk
closed_stage: legal risk classification and accountability baseline
missing_stage: compliance deployment inventory notice human review appeal and payment continuity
next_test: obtain a deployment inventory and verify logs oversight notices and appeal records
